full_page.content:
1932, February
FR. SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 5.
Page 20 Cont.
Feb. 2 Miss Therese Martin - little girl 3 - bright happy but can only few words, also .... . ... Mrs. Pactold
Page 21
Feb. 4 Three Ribs gone - 3 more threatened. Catherine Kiss - 23 - T.B. - in Kiefer Hospital. In effort to colapse left lung Dr's have taken three ribs from her back. They want to take three more shortly.
Feb. 10 Operated To-day
McDonough Boys 25 & 23 threatened with T.B. - one has it & in Hosp. Mrs. Horton - in St. Joseph's Mrs. Klumpp - Stom. cancer Mrs. D ..... Asthma
Niece Bern - 7 - Asthma
Mrs. Trouberkrout - pneumonia
Feb. 12 Cath. Austin 11 of Mansfield, 0. - 7 months in bed - streptacoctic infection - doctors baffled that she still lives.
Baby Dominic Brillo - 18 mo - better gaining .... 2 lbs in 18 days Vocation threatened - home 7 months - now doubting about it - Jaworski
Page 22 Feb. 15 Albert Troy - 48 - has wife & 3 children - one a Dominican Nun - almost blind.
Battaglia (Jos.) in Dearborn - went to a medium - lost his faith then his mind.
Vincent Govanski - 9 - crooked leg and weak - fear of operation Mrs. Dionne (Helen) ?? Crazy? Employment
